question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

He made an appoitment with the dentist for next week.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appoitment"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"appointment"**.
 
• **"Appoitment" **is not a valid word in the English language.
 
• **"Appointment" **(अपॉइंटमेंट) means an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
 
 
• **Example:** She scheduled an appointment with the doctor for next Monday.
 
 

Therefore, the correct word is **appointment** (अपॉइंटमेंट).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Made** (बनाया): Refers to something that has been created or produced.

 
 
• **Example:** He made a beautiful sculpture out of clay.
 
 
 
• **Dentist** (दंत चिकित्सक): A doctor who specializes in the care of teeth.
 
 
• **Example:** I visited the dentist to get my teeth cleaned.
 
 
 
• **Next** (अगला): Refers to something coming immediately after the present one.
 
 
• **Example:** We will discuss the next chapter tomorrow.
